from.label: VAV item
from.note: Which VAV Box sheet item this line is: a VAV box (a VAV or CAV terminal box); the VAV Integrator; a BACnet over IP controller; a duct connection; a conical piece; integrator cabling (per metre); or the installation of a VAV box of any size. Answer 'none of these' for anything else and copy its words into 'VAV item as written'. A duct connection only when the row ASKS for one (e.g. 'with flexible duct connection'); a row that only says the box is 'suitable for duct connections' describes the box - that is NOT a duct connection item.

from.label: VAV item as written
from.note: The item in the BoQ's own words. Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value.

from.label: Shape
from.note: VAV boxes only: Rectangular or Oval, as the BoQ states.

from.label: Type
from.note: VAV box: Nothing specific mentioned, AHRI Certified, or AHRI Certified Imported. VAV Integrator: Nothing specific mentioned or Imported. As the BoQ states.

from.label: Integrator included in this rate
from.note: VAV boxes only: Yes when the box's rate includes its VAV integrator, No when it does not.

from.label: Airflow (CFM)
from.note: VAV boxes only: the airflow as the BoQ writes it, in CFM, e.g. '650 CFM', 'Up to 650 CFM', '500-650 CFM'; a range as written (the maximum is used). Answer 'None' if no airflow is stated. A lower limit only ('Above 3200 CFM', '3700 CFM above'): copy it with its word, e.g. 'Above 3200 CFM'.

from.label: Inlet size
from.note: VAV boxes only: the round inlet size as the BoQ writes it, in inches or mm, e.g. '8 inch', '200 mm dia'. Not a tag or item number. Answer 'None' if no inlet size is stated.

from.label: Airflow band (CFM)
from.note: VAV boxes only: the airflow band of the box on the VAV Box sheet, in CFM.

from.label: Qty per box
from.note: How many of this item go with one row unit (one box); for integrator cabling, the metres per box. Two of an item when the row asks for two ('two thermostats'; a piece 'on either side' = 2).

from.label: Scope
from.note: What the row pays for: supply + installation, supply only, or installation only. 'None' when nothing is said.

from.label: Controller for the VAVs
from.note: VAV boxes only. Read THIS row's whole payload (its description, its own notes and the notes of the headings above it): is a controller FOR CONTROLLING THE VAVs mentioned? Only a controller that is for controlling the VAVs counts. 'ddc_inclusive' = a DDC controller or DDC panel (the two are the same thing) is part of the VAV box or its controller and the text makes it part of the price (e.g. 'Independent DDC VAV Controller with inbuilt pressure sensor', a box 'consisting of' / 'complete with' ... a DDC controller, 'inclusive of DDC controller'). 'ddc' = a DDC controller or DDC panel is part of the VAV box or its controller but the text does not say it is included. 'bacnet' = BACnet in any form (BACnet over IP, BACnet MS/TP, BACnet alone) for the VAV box, its controller or the VAV network. 'controller' = a controller for the VAVs with neither a DDC nor a BACnet word (e.g. 'controller for receiving Temp. & DP Signal', 'required controllers for controlling all the VAVs', the VAVs 'shall communicate through a network controller'). 'none' = no controller for the VAVs. NOT counted (answer as if those words were absent): a DDC or BACnet controller of OTHER equipment (an AHU's 'BACNET/IP DDC', a 'centralised controller for VFD operation'); a line about makes ('All VAV controllers, DDC controllers ... shall be of single OEM' names no DDC for the VAVs - its BACnet controllers still count as 'bacnet' when BACnet is named for the VAVs). When more than one applies, answer the first of: ddc_inclusive, ddc, bacnet, controller.

from.label: Controller by others
from.note: VAV boxes only: 'Yes' when the text says the VAV controller is supplied or installed by the BMS vendor or by others (e.g. '(VAV controllers and thermostats will be installed by the BMS vendor at site)'); otherwise 'No'.

from.label: DP sensor mentioned
from.note: VAV boxes only: 'Yes' when THIS row's payload mentions a DP sensor for the VAVs in any form - a differential pressure sensor, switch or transmitter, a 'DP sensor' / 'DPS', a duct static pressure sensor; every DP sensor mention counts. 'No' otherwise. A 'DP signal' alone, a pressure gauge, an air-flow monitoring station or the box's own velocity sensor is not a DP sensor.
